Organization 2: Ometz Agency URL: https://macommunaute.ca/bottin-des-agences/agenceometz/
Website: http://www.ometz.ca/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details 5151
chemin Côte-Sainte-Catherine, Montreal QC H3W 1M6 514-342-0000 514-342-2371 Social
networks Mission JOIN OUR TEAM AND HELP TRANSFORM LIVES Agence Ometz is an
organization of charity that supports and encourages individuals and families by offering a wide
range of social, educational, employment and immigration services. Our work is guided by our
values fundamental: autonomy, inclusion, human dignity, supportive communities and excellence.
We are dedicated to helping those who seek our support to achieve their full potential and improve
their quality of life. By joining the Ometz Agency, you will work with a team of professionals who are
compassionate, committed and inspiring. Apply today! Description Building on over 150 years of
excellent community service, Agence Ometz was created in April 2008. It is the result of the merger
of Emploi Juif Montréal (JEM), Jewish Family Services (JFS) and Jewish Immigrant Assistance
Services (JIAS). The Ometz Agency offers a whole range of integrated services relating to all
stages of life. We are committed to strengthening those who are going through difficult times in their
lives. In 1863, when Montreal had just under 1,000 Jews, a group of leaders communities met in a
store on rue Saint-Jacques and created the Young Men’s Hebrew Benevolent Society. They were
then far from suspecting that they were founding what would later become Jewish Family Services
(JFS). The growing wave of immigrants to Canada, partly due to the many newcomers fleeing their
country and who risked being deported upon their arrival, justified the creation of Assistance
Services for Jewish Immigrants (JIAS) in 1922. Over the years, JIAS has helped hundreds of
thousands of Jewish immigrants in their immigration application procedures and to settle in
Canada. In 1945, Jewish Employment Montreal (JEM) was founded to meet the needs of Canadian
veterans war and people arriving from Europe in search of work. By the variety of services offered
to job seekers and employers, JEM has become a Montreal leader in employment and placement
matters. Currently, there are more than 13,000 people per year who contact the Ometz Agency with
the aim of improving their quality of life. The Agency offers a set of services for the whole family
whether it concerns difficulties experienced following the breakdown of family or mental illness,
financial issues, looking for a job or installation in Montreal.

PERREAULT Director general 5144841471 extension: 230 Communicate with this contact Mission
Parents committed to early childhood has the mission of offering, developing and supporting,
particularly in Quebec, primarily home-based programs aimed at improving the aptitude of
immigrant parents and from disadvantaged backgrounds to strengthen their children's ability to
learn at a young age as well as than to better prepare them for school. Description Program
Activities are offered at each visit, to families' homes, 30 weeks per year by home workers. Home
visits are made every week or every two weeks, depending on the needs of the parents. The
activities, both fun and educational, are focused on the development overall health of the child.
Parents become familiar with the observation and development of skills through play and daily
activities at home. The speaker brings a new book in the family, so that parent and child enjoy
exploring a diversity of books and establish a reading routine at home. Thus, the parent is made
aware of the importance of exposing your child to reading to support them in their language
development in particular. The targeted skills work on language, the development of fine motor
skills and overall, memory and listening skills, as well as emotional development and coordination
oculo-manual. Additionally, parents can discuss parenting techniques with the speaker and we also
do SEO. Group activities Group activities group on different subjects and outings are organized for

Website: https://www.carejeunesse.org/ Description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Contact details
7141 rue Sherbrooke Ouest, VE 223-7, Montreal QC H4B 1R6 Opening hours SCHEDULE by
appointment Mission Our mission at C.A.R.E Jeunesse aims to improve the quality of life of young
people in care and formerly placed in care. providing support, resources and empowerment

Youth (C.A.R.E Jeunesse) is a provincial bilingual non-profit organization dedicated to cultivating
community and voice for young people in care and formerly placed people. For most young people,
the transition to adulthood can be difficult. However, for the 2000 young people who stop being
taken care of every year in Quebec, this transition is even more complex. This is where C.A.R.E
Youth intervenes. Founded by former placements who themselves experienced the system, our
The organization’s mission is to help these young adults after they leave. We aim to improve their
living conditions, to provide them with a community of support and to help them build a better future.
When a young adult who leaves childcare services finds himself facing difficulties, whether finding
accommodation, food, help with procedures administrative, or simply someone with whom to share
the holidays, he can count on C.A.R.E Jeunesse to establish these connections and offer support
adapted to their needs. Our mission: Provide a safe environment to connect and build supportive
relationships Provide opportunities for advocacy, education and empowerment Connecting youth to
resources necessary Review policies relating to young people in care Provide training and
consultations with professionals on these issues Our values: Community Autonomy Inclusion
Accountability Advocacy Respect Well-being C.A.R.E Jeunesse is very inclusive and welcomes
members of all backgrounds, abilities, cultures, religions, genders, orientations sexual and ethnic
groups. Our objective is to support and accompany all young and old placed, offering a space for
listening and support to allow them to flourish despite challenges encountered.
